prompt: A professional film storyboard sheet: a clean grid of 6 panels in 2 rows of 3 columns (if fewer panels are listed, leave the extra slots plain light grey), thin white gutters, light grey background. Each panel has a large bold black number in its top-left corner: 15, 16, 17, 18, 19. No other text, letters or numbers anywhere. HIGHLY CINEMATIC frames, like stills from a Tim Burton / Wes Anderson feature film: dramatic motivated lighting with a strong top key light and soft violet rim light, light haze in the air, deep shadows graded toward deep violet, glossy reflections on the floor, subtle film grain, anamorphic lens feel, very shallow depth of field, bold unusual camera angles (worm's-eye, extreme low angle, dutch angle, extreme macro). Set: lilac #A99BFF cube room, glossy near-black and cream checkerboard floor, one neon-lime yellow #EEFE3A square. NEUS's side of the board has nail polish bottles (lilac, deep violet, near-black, neon-lime); the opposite side has real glossy black chess pieces. Characters: NEUS = the woman from the reference images (identical face, long straight dark-brown hair with center part, sleek black leather suit, gold hoops, confident). THE DOUBLE = the exact same woman, same face and same straight hair slightly messy, beige oversized chunky knit sweater, unsure look. When both appear they are at OPPOSITE ends of the board. Correct anatomy and hands, photorealistic. Panel 15: extreme macro of NEUS's eye and eyebrow, a small neon-lime notification glow reflected in the iris. Panel 16: NEUS mid-somersault across the checkerboard, frozen in mid-air, motion blur on the hair, low angle, haze backlight. Panel 17: camera on the floor, side profile: NEUS lying on her side at her end, cheek on the floor, pushing the deep violet bottle with one finger toward a black king in sharp focus in the centre; THE DOUBLE out of focus at the opposite end, watching. Panel 18: extreme low angle macro: the deep violet bottle (staying upright) knocks the black king over onto the neon-lime square, burst of light and sparks; in the far background THE DOUBLE smiles softly and fades, translucent. Panel 19: wide symmetrical hero shot: NEUS alone standing in the centre of the cube, confident, dramatic top light, the board in front of her, empty space at the bottom.
